content.text: The second push attempt worked; the first failure looks temporary. Now the PR:

arguments.command:
cd /home/runner/work/pi-action/pi-action; cat > /tmp/pr.md <<'EOF'
Fixes #42.

## Why pi answered twice in #39

Each pair of answers came from **one** run, not two runs:

| Run | pi's own comment (`gh issue comment`) | pi-action's `### 🤖 pi Response` |
|-----|------|------|
| [43138470608](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43138470608) (release, after the ticked box) | [02:04:52](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/39#issuecomment-6812229071) | [02:05:03](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/39#issuecomment-6812232463) |
| [43139596718](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43139596718) ("what commitlint patch?") | [02:11:40](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/39#issuecomment-6812338400) | [02:11:46](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/39#issuecomment-6812340023) |

`refs/pi/threads/39` has the tool call: `gh issue comment 39 --body-file /tmp/reply.md`. pi's final message even says "I posted this correction on #39: …#issuecomment-6812338400". Then pi-action posted that final message as the usual reply.

The workflow and its triggers worked correctly. The other runs at those times were `skipped` by the `sender.type != 'Bot'` guard, and the `concurrency` group kept the runs in order.

The cause: **nothing told pi that pi-action posts its final response.** The tools get `GH_TOKEN`. Since #40, that is the App's token, so `gh issue comment` works and the comment shows as `pi-action-agent`. The built-in prompt only says "commit and push all work". From that, pi decided to "deliver" its answer itself.

## The fix

When pi-action posts the reply (`output_mode: comment` on an issue or PR), it now says so:

- **First message:** the built-in prompt has a new `## Your Reply` section, between `## Task` and the requirements block. It tells pi not to post its reply with `gh issue comment`, `gh pr comment`, `gh pr review`, or `gh api`, and to comment only where the task asks for it (such as on another issue).
- **Follow-ups and answers:** each one ends with a one-line reminder: _(pi-action posts your final response as a comment here. Don't also post it with `gh`.)_ Existing threads such as #39 never see the new first message, so they need this. In long threads, it also stops pi from forgetting the rule.

In `output_mode: output` and with direct prompts, the messages do not change. A custom `prompt_template` is still the complete first message, but its follow-ups get the reminder.

`docs/prompts.md` now describes this in a new "The reply" section.

## Not in this PR (options to consider)

The prompt asks pi not to do this, but nothing stops it. Stricter options:
- Don't post the final response when pi already commented on the same issue during the request. A delivery would then be missing whenever pi's comment was only a side note.
- Give the agent's tools a token without `issues: write`. That would block legitimate work, such as opening issues ("Open another issue to create the 2.2.2 release" in #39).

## Verification

`npm run check` passes (typecheck, oxlint/oxfmt, actionlint, coverage, knip, jscpd). The new and updated tests:
- `src/context.test.ts`: `## Your Reply` appears only with `repliesAsComment`, after `## Task` and before the requirements. A custom template is unchanged. Also tests `withReplyReminder`.
- `src/run.test.ts`: the first message of a comment-mode thread has `## Your Reply`. The follow-up and the answer to a question end with the reminder.
EOF
gh pr create --base main --head fix/42-duplicate-replies --title "fix: tell pi that pi-action posts its reply, so it doesn't post it twice" --body-file /tmp/pr.md
